annotations.text:
West Coast Mediators homepage, restyled with screentune.app-style motion — real brand tokens (navy/forest/gold, Playfair + Montserrat + Lato), real site copy.

Effects: custom cursor, scroll progress bar, film-grain overlay, parallax hero blobs, split-text headline reveal, marquee ribbon, scramble/decode stat text, scroll-triggered reveals, magnetic buttons, 3D tilt cards, cursor-spotlight glow on dark sections, animated nav + mobile menu, working contact form state.

Toggle the Motion tweak above the artboard to compare with effects off.
